entries.Original: Open or close Mnemosyne. /mnemo settings, /mnemo <character name>, /mnemo dump, /mnemo help
entries.Translated: 打开或关闭 Mnemosyne。/mnemo settings、/mnemo <角色名>、/mnemo dump、/mnemo help

entries.Original: not logged in; nothing to dump
entries.Translated: 未登录；没有可导出的内容

entries.Original: sheet dump skipped: the catalog was not built from the game data; see the log
entries.Translated: 表格导出已跳过：目录并非由游戏数据构建；请查看日志
（在插件配置文件夹的 sheets 中）

entries.Original: The file holds every character's name, world, content id and progress, and your settings. Mnemosyne writes it only where you choose and never sends it anywhere.
entries.Translated: 该文件包含每个角色的名称、服务器、内容 ID 和进度，以及你的设置。Mnemosyne 只会将其写入你选择的位置，绝不会发送到任何地方。

entries.Original: Export cancelled; the existing file was kept.
entries.Translated: 导出已取消；已保留现有文件。

entries.Original: without the settings, because this PC's settings file could not be read or is from a newer build,
entries.Translated: 不含设置，因为此电脑的设置文件无法读取或来自更新的版本，
个角色已添加或替换；设置

entries.Original: Counted only while Mnemosyne was running; anything done with it off is not seen.
entries.Translated: 仅在 Mnemosyne 运行时计数；关闭时完成的内容不会被记录。

entries.Original: no gil history yet; it starts when a character's gil is read, and the graph fills in as days pass
entries.Translated: 暂无金币记录；读取角色金币后开始记录，随着天数增加图表会逐渐填充

entries.Original: ; the graph fills in as days pass
entries.Translated: ；随着天数增加图表会逐渐填充

entries.Original: Log into a character and it appears here.
entries.Translated: 登录角色后便会显示在这里。

entries.Original: Make a role on the settings page.
entries.Translated: 在设置页面创建一个定位。

entries.Original: ? Its file is deleted. Logging into the character again starts a fresh record.
entries.Translated: ？其文件将被删除。再次登录该角色会重新开始记录。

entries.Original: Things the game cannot tell Mnemosyne, ticked by hand per character: in the character's own list, or beside its name under the task's All tasks line.
entries.Translated: 游戏无法告知 Mnemosyne 的事项，需按角色手动勾选：在角色自己的列表中，或在任务“所有任务”行中其名称旁。

entries.Original: Each click on the box adds one, and the task is done at this number. 1 is a plain tick.
entries.Translated: 每次点击方框增加一次，达到此数字时任务完成。1 即为普通勾选。

entries.Original: Make a role in the Roles section to give a task to one role.
entries.Translated: 在“角色”部分创建一个角色，即可将任务分配给某个角色。

entries.Original: a role not on this PC (nobody)
Nobody is picked yet, so the task is for nobody.
entries.Translated: 尚未选择任何人，因此该任务没有对象。

entries.Original: "? It leaves every character's list. The ticks already made stay in the records, unread.
entries.Translated: ”？它会从每个角色的列表中移除。已完成的勾选仍保留在记录中，未读。

entries.Original: A role switches categories and groups off for the characters that have it: their rows stay in their own list, dimmed, and are never counted. Give a character its role from its right-click menu in the sidebar, or tick several in All characters and use Give role.
entries.Translated: 角色会为拥有它的角色关闭分类和分组：它们的行仍保留在自己的列表中，变暗，且从不计入。在侧边栏中通过角色的右键菜单为其分配角色，或在“所有角色”中勾选多个并使用“分配角色”。

entries.Original: that name is taken or reserved
entries.Translated: 该名称已被占用或保留

entries.Original: Switch off what this role leaves out. Switching on one group inside a category that is off switches the category back on, with only that group on.
entries.Translated: 关闭此角色排除的内容。在已关闭的分类中开启某一组会重新开启该分类，且仅开启该组。

entries.Original: it, and will track everything again, as with no role, and show as 'unknown role' until given another role or None
entries.Translated: 它，并将重新追踪所有内容（如同无角色），在分配其他角色或“无”之前显示为“未知角色”

entries.Original: for it will be for nobody until given another role.
entries.Translated: 在分配其他角色之前将不属于任何人。

entries.Original: Mnemosyne stores character data only on this PC. It is never uploaded anywhere. It reads the game and never writes to it; its optional switch button asks Lifestream to change character. Log into each character once and it appears in the list. Type /mnemo to open it.
entries.Translated: Mnemosyne 仅将角色数据存储在本机。绝不会上传到任何地方。它只读取游戏，从不写入；其可选开关按钮会请求 Lifestream 切换角色。每个角色登录一次后便会出现在列表中。输入 /mnemo 打开。

entries.Original: Mnemosyne stores character data only on this PC. It is never uploaded anywhere.
entries.Translated: Mnemosyne 仅将角色数据存储在本机。绝不会上传到任何地方。

entries.Original: Settings will not be saved this session: the file could not be read or is from a newer build.
entries.Translated: 本次会话不会保存设置：文件无法读取或来自更新的版本。

entries.Original: Its tile, its row and its holdings are dimmed, and marked as possibly out of date.
entries.Translated: 其卡片、行和持有物将变暗，并标记为可能已过期。

entries.Original: An event or a deadline this close to its end is listed under Ending soon.
entries.Translated: 临近结束的事件或截止时间会列在“即将结束”下。

entries.Original: When off, the badge counts only what is ending soon and what is due today.
entries.Translated: 关闭时，徽章仅计入即将结束和今日到期的事项。

entries.Original: How often the logged-in character's values are read again while you play.
entries.Translated: 游玩时重新读取已登录角色数值的频率。

entries.Original: Nothing is said in chat during a duty, a cutscene or combat.
entries.Translated: 在任务、过场动画或战斗中不在聊天中提示。

entries.Original: After you log in, one line saying how many things are to do, with a link that opens Mnemosyne's main window.
entries.Translated: 登录后，用一行提示有多少事项待办，并附打开 Mnemosyne 主窗口的链接。

entries.Original: The same count in the server info bar at the top of the screen; a click on it opens Mnemosyne's main window.
entries.Translated: 在屏幕顶部的服务器信息栏显示相同计数；点击可打开 Mnemosyne 主窗口。

entries.Original: One chat line after the daily reset while something is still to do today.
entries.Translated: 每日重置后若今日仍有待办事项，显示一行聊天提示。

entries.Original: One chat line when an event not done yet moves into Ending soon.
entries.Translated: 当尚未完成的事件进入“即将结束”时，显示一行聊天提示。
提醒：天书奇谈即将过期

entries.Original: One chat line when your Wondrous Tails journal is close to expiring.
entries.Translated: 当你的天书奇谈即将过期时，显示一行聊天提示。

entries.Original: One chat line when the game's own warning says a house needs a visit.
entries.Translated: 当游戏自身的警告提示需要访问房屋时，显示一行聊天提示。
提醒：重置前的我的任务

entries.Original: An hour before each daily and weekly reset, one line naming the My tasks still to do.
entries.Translated: 每日和每周重置前一小时，用一行列出尚未完成的我的任务。

entries.Original: An hour before the daily and the weekly reset, one chat line naming the daily or weekly My tasks this character still has to do.
entries.Translated: 每日和每周重置前一小时，用一行聊天信息列出该角色尚未完成的每日或每周我的任务。

entries.Original: A category switched off is left out of every character's list, the badge and All tasks.
entries.Translated: 关闭的分类不会出现在任何角色的列表、徽章和全部任务中。

entries.Original: Rows ignored on every character, from a row's right-click menu.
entries.Translated: 通过行右键菜单在所有角色上忽略的行。

entries.Original: Click a name to show that character in the list again.
entries.Translated: 点击名称可让该角色重新显示在列表中。

entries.Original: Rows ignored on one character only.
entries.Translated: 仅在单个角色上忽略的行。

entries.Original: The main scenario, and the class, job, role and other quest lines.
entries.Translated: 主线任务，以及职业、特职、职能和其他任务线。

entries.Original: Each class and job's level, and your Grand Company.
entries.Translated: 各职业和特职的等级，以及你的大国防联军。

entries.Original: Seasonal events, collaboration quests and the Moogle Treasure Trove.
entries.Translated: 季节活动、联动任务和莫古力宝物库。

entries.Original: Dailies and weeklies: roulettes, hunts, Wondrous Tails, the challenge log and more.
entries.Translated: 每日和每周：随机任务、狩猎、天书奇谈、挑战笔记等。

entries.Original: Housing, PvP, the Gold Saucer, field operations, deep dungeons and every duty.
entries.Translated: 房屋、PvP、金碟游乐场、特殊场景探索、深层迷宫和所有任务。

entries.Original: Mounts, minions and more, the crafting, gathering and sightseeing logs, and achievements.
entries.Translated: 坐骑、宠物等，制作、采集和观光笔记，以及成就。

entries.Original: Gil, tomestones and other currencies, retainers and storage.
entries.Translated: 金币、诗学神典石和其他货币、雇员和仓库。

entries.Original: The tasks you add by hand in the My tasks section below.
entries.Translated: 你在下方“我的任务”区域手动添加的任务。

entries.Original: right-click a task to pin, prioritise, snooze or hide it
entries.Translated: 右键点击任务可固定、优先、延后或隐藏

entries.Original: Nothing to do on any character.
entries.Translated: 所有角色都没有要做的任务。

entries.Original: every character in the list, as each last showed it; open a line to see who holds it
entries.Translated: 列表中每个角色，按各自最后显示的状态；展开一行可查看由谁持有
